summary: Nightly flat file export of pharmacy prescriptions containing patient MRNs, RxNorm drug codes, dosage descriptions, prescribed quantities, start dates, and prescription status flags.

access.notes: Read-only access to pipe-delimited (|) CSV files matching pattern rx_export_*.csv in a designated runtime path.

entities.name: Prescription
entities.description: Represents a single medication prescription record issued to a patient. New files are exported daily and may contain repeated or updated prescription entries.

fields.name: DRUG_DESC
fields.meaning: Text description of medication name, dose, and form

cross_system_keys.meaning: Links prescription records to master patient index and EHR demographic records

value_map.895994: 120 ACTUAT Fluticasone propionate 0.044 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler

data_quality_notes: Duplicate RX_NO values across export files (60 distinct across 65 total rows), indicating multiple daily snapshots contain overlapping prescription records.
Dates in START_DT use DD/MM/YYYY format without explicit time or timezone offset.
Numeric values like MRN, RXNORM_CD, and QTY are formatted as string representations of integers.
open_questions: What exact business status names correspond to local STAT codes 'A', 'C', and 'S'?
Are daily export files incremental delta updates or full cumulative extracts of pharmacy prescriptions?
Should multiple instances of the same RX_NO across daily files be processed as upserts (overwrites) or deduplicated?
